study.question: Can removing separate category and brand marginal concentration summaries, while retaining exact joint pair/context statistics, full16 embeddings and full16 context/transition states, retain direct_lifted utility and measurably reduce end-to-end cost?
study.hypothesis: Observation: all three initial references succeeded (AUC static0.6050036, pooled0.6102261, DIN-adapted0.6133620); frozen direct_lifted reached0.6304316804 at788.54s wall/676.14s train/25.02s inference. Context compression in round25 yielded action0.6297515 and rotated0.6299634 versus shared_full0.6307423; width8 in round26 yielded0.6296234/0.6297729/0.6299921 versus full0.6304134, with no reliable cost advantage. Round27 overlap removal0.6303146 did not reveal a clear overlap requirement versus full0.6300265; this is provisional, not proof of irrelevance. Round28 H2 reduced AUC0.0003380 relative to exact sparse and appeared faster, but round29 third-moment correction0.6302002 versus Shannon0.6301514 was slower (718.86 versus713.57s wall;22.46 versus22.70s inference), so approximation has not established repeated efficiency. Exact sparse itself varied0.6304874 to0.6301514 across repeated seed42 executions; timings varied732.38 to713.57s. Source inspection shows two marginal sorts feed only category/brand entropy and collision coordinates in identity_head, while a third joint sort feeds the retained fine joint summaries. Mechanism hypothesis: these marginal scalar summaries add little conditional predictive utility beyond the unchanged learned field representation, exact pair identity, fine context recurrence and temporal branches. Removing only them may avoid two sorts with less harmful information loss than coarsening contexts, reducing dimensions, or approximating all entropies. Marginal-sort runtime share and marginal utility are unmeasured; no bottleneck or sufficiency is asserted yet.

nearest_work.difference: Immediate implementation parent. Reuse sparse nested-run Shannon counts and zero overlap; remove only two marginal distribution calls and set the four marginal coordinates per group to zero. Joint summaries remain exact. Also compare repeated byte-identical g2-r0029-shannon_reference; no new entropy estimator.

Retained stronger utility anchor, not a new execution of the frozen source in this round. Inherited architecture differs through prior selected/shared/sparse execution and overlap removal, so total savings versus this anchor cannot all be attributed to the new marginal removal.

DIN uses learned target-conditioned weighted history pooling (section4.3), whereas this contrast ablates marginal empirical concentration summaries inside an inherited target-match grouped model. No DIN reproduction or priority claim. The baseline_reference uses normalized softmax, unlike DIN section4.3; it is explicitly an adaptation.

study.proposed_difference: In candidate.py final Model._sparse_recurrence only, replace the two _sparse_distribution calls with zero category/brand entropy/collision tensors. This zeroes16 identity_head input coordinates and eliminates their two per-impression sorts. Retain identity count/joint entropy/joint collision, complete fine-context joint summaries and all other forward branches. The 256 associated first-layer identity weights receive zero feature gradient, so allocated capacity is matched but effective feature capacity is reduced. This is an information-changing removal contrast; a diagnostic computes exact-then-masked blocks with the same weights to verify its execution, without claiming training of that diagnostic is a third trial. No source-priority or new-method novelty claim; literature search of authorized registry found no specific entropy-sufficiency source.
predictions: Prospective utility gate: candidate full-population validation AUC >= frozen direct_lifted0.6304316803980214 minus0.0005 (=0.6299316803980214), AND candidate AUC no more than0.0005 below this round exact-Shannon control. Candidate unweighted Logloss must worsen by at most0.0001 against both frozen direct_lifted0.19269404064402526 and current exact control. These are operational screening margins, not confidence-based noninferiority conclusions.

Cost gate: predict at least3% lower measured training seconds OR end-to-end inference seconds versus the fresh exact control at identical full recipe, batch size and host timing scope including feature gathering, with no >3% increase in the other measure. Report wall seconds, throughput,p50/p95,memory,parameters and examples processed separately. Single-run pass is preliminary; reproducible efficiency requires validation-only repetition with matching utility and cost direction, not theoretical sort counts.

Diagnostics should report exactly1 selected recurrence sort versus3 in source reference, zero omitted coordinates, exact-minus-masked retained-feature/logit error <=1e-6, and count-conservation error0 on <=8 validation impressions. Source operation counts are analytic annotations, not measured timings. Dense-oracle statistic error <=1e-6; finite logits and padding/reversal invariance of these summaries, including empty/missing/zero-length inputs.

Report absolute and relative utility/cost versus g1-r0020-direct_lifted and incumbent g2-r0025-shared_full, without selecting a favorable historical run. Report seed42 repeat variation and all outcomes. Existing host history contains no retrievable pooled_observed/sketch256 comparison receipts (registry search returned no matches); baseline-pooled is a distinct reference and will not be substituted. The task-wide frontier versus those two named models remains unresolved until authorized receipts are available.
falsifiers: Failure of either AUC-retention gate or Logloss tolerance falsifies the proposed operational utility retention for this implementation, regardless of apparent speed.
No >=3% measured improvement in either training or inference, >3% regression in the other, or a reversal under admissible repetition fails the efficiency gate even if two sorts disappear.

Nonzero retained-feature/masked-logit discrepancy beyond1e-6, nonconserved counts, invalid sample output or nonfinite logits is an implementation failure, not scientific counterevidence against marginal redundancy. Do not repair scorers, splits, history boundaries or frozen recipe.

Pair summaries cannot in general determine marginal summaries: histories [(c1,b1),(c1,b2)] versus[(c1,b1),(c2,b2)] have identical joint entropy/collision but category entropy differs log2 and collision differs0.5. Therefore success would support local predictive redundancy within this model/protocol, not universal mathematical sufficiency.
alternative_explanations: Small AUC/Logloss deltas may be initialization, nondeterministic execution, checkpoint selection or repeated-validation selection effects; same-seed repeated execution is not independent mechanism evidence.

Reduction of effective feature capacity may act as regularization. The identical allocated network cannot distinguish that explanation from redundant marginal information; no claim about identity information causality beyond this removal is permitted.

Two saved sorts may be a small fraction of embedding optimizer/feature gathering cost; GPU kernel overhead, timing jitter or nonlinear interaction with the inherited sparse execution may erase savings.
The zero-overlap parent itself is not fully validated by multiple seeds against frozen direct_lifted; inherited engineering changes can explain total historical savings.

Static benchmark user/ad snapshot timestamps are undocumented, category/brand buckets have coarser identity than items, long-history impressions dominate, and observed validation utility does not establish production point-in-time or held-out generalization.
